from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u081/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-30773d05.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    occupied_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    if not occupied_rows:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(occupied_rows)
    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        shift = bottom - r if r <= bottom and any(v != 0 for v in row) else 0
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            nc = c - shift
            if value != 0 and 0 <= nc < width:
                out[r][nc] = value
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
print(program_path, program_path.exists())
